tasks.subject: 生物
tasks.title: 种群成长模型与收支
teaching_purpose: 由出生死亡迁入迁出分析种群变化
比较成长模型与抽样估计的条件
scientific_relations: K/2为固定参数总增长率峰
formulas_units_variables: 种群收支：N末=N初+B+I−D−E；密度=N/相应面积或体积。
理想固定倍增：N=N₀×2^(t/g)；逻辑斯谛模型增长速率rN(1−N/K)，固定参数时在K/2最大。
标记重捕估计N≈M×n/m，其中M首标记数、n重捕总数、m重捕中带标记数，m>0且假设需审。
tasks.composition: 2–3个分面，主图和条件/计算框分开；精确方向和连接，48 px安全边距；不以颜色作为唯一编码。
tasks.prompt_zh: 为UEC高中生物第10章《生态系统》真实小节10.1《种群》制作《种群成长模型与收支》教学图。学习目的：由出生死亡迁入迁出分析种群变化；比较成长模型与抽样估计的条件。本图是有条件的科学模型，非实测图或官方考题。必须出现：N-t指数/逻辑斯谛图；增长率对N图；B/I/D/E收支；标记重捕比例。必须保持关系：K/2为固定参数总增长率峰；每个体增长率不同；m=0时不能除法估无限大。中文标签逐字采用：N、t、K、K/2、rN(1−N/K)、M/N≈m/n。公式及条件：种群收支：N末=N初+B+I−D−E；密度=N/相应面积或体积。；理想固定倍增：N=N₀×2^(t/g)；逻辑斯谛模型增长速率rN(1−N/K)，固定参数时在K/2最大。；标记重捕估计N≈M×n/m，其中M首标记数、n重捕总数、m重捕中带标记数，m>0且假设需审。。以2至3个逻辑清楚的面板排列，主结构居左或居上，计算/条件框居右或居下；箭头起止与文字引线不得穿过无关对象，不用颜色单独编码差异。使用浅底深线，必要以线型和形状区分，避免浅灰小字。建议1280×960、4:3，正文等效字号至少24 px，四周留48 px安全边距；手机可整体缩放并放大查看，最小标签不得裁切。科学结构、坐标、数值、曲线、刻度、单位和公式须用SVG或数学绘图库精确构造；若先用AI，只可作构图草稿，不能直接发布。逐项按验收标准复核。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a UEC senior-high biology teaching diagram for chapter 10, authentic subsection 10.1. Display the original Chinese title exactly: 种群成长模型与收支. Topic-specific scientific requirements and instructional purpose: Plot population size versus time for explicitly idealized exponential and logistic models, separately plot logistic total growth rate versus N with its peak at K/2, and distinguish per-capita growth. Include birth/death/immigration/emigration accounting and conditional mark-recapture proportions. This is a conditional teaching model, not measured data or an official examination figure. Required Chinese-labelled objects, which must all appear: N-t指数/逻辑斯谛图；增长率对N图；B/I/D/E收支；标记重捕比例. Preserve the following Chinese label strings exactly: N、t、K、K/2、rN(1−N/K)、M/N≈m/n. Typeset the reference formulas, units and conditions below as literal label/annotation content, checking every sign and symbol: 种群收支：N末=N初+B+I−D−E；密度=N/相应面积或体积。；理想固定倍增：N=N₀×2^(t/g)；逻辑斯谛模型增长速率rN(1−N/K)，固定参数时在K/2最大。；标记重捕估计N≈M×n/m，其中M首标记数、n重捕总数、m重捕中带标记数，m>0且假设需审。. Use two or three clearly separated panels, with the principal structure at top or left and condition/calculation boxes below or right. Never cross unrelated structures with arrows or callouts; every arrow must have a scientifically correct start and end. Never rely on colour alone: use shapes and line styles. Render a light background with dark high-contrast lines. Target 1280 by 960 pixels, 4:3, minimum 24-pixel equivalent labels and 48-pixel safe margins. Keep every label inside the viewBox and support mobile zoom. Construct quantitative geometry, curves, tick marks, formulas, apparatus and scientific structures deterministically in SVG or a mathematical plotting library. AI output may only be a composition draft, requiring independent scientific checks before publication. The main figure is a specified model; do not silently transfer its numbers to a different worked example or exercise.

tasks.title: 能流收支与碳氮磷循环
teaching_purpose: 以收支区分生产量同化与呼吸

Clearly mark capsule, plasmid and flagellum as optional structures. This is a conditional teaching model, not measured data or an official examination figure. Required Chinese-labelled objects, which must all appear: 细胞膜；肽聚糖壁；拟核；核糖体；可选质粒荚膜鞭毛. Preserve the following Chinese label strings exactly: 拟核、核糖体、细胞膜、细胞壁、部分细菌具有. Typeset the reference formulas, units and conditions below as literal label/annotation content, checking every sign and symbol: 球形模型表面积A=4πr²、体积V=4πr³/3，所以A/V=3/r；半径减半，表面积体积比加倍。；细菌能量代谢的论证应从膜、酶和反应途径出发，不能由“无粒线体”推出“无ATP”。；结构识别须区分必备的细胞膜、核糖体等与部分细菌才有的质粒、荚膜和鞭毛。. Use two or three clearly separated panels, with the principal structure at top or left and condition/calculation boxes below or right. Never cross unrelated structures with arrows or callouts; every arrow must have a scientifically correct start and end. Never rely on colour alone: use shapes and line styles. tasks.prompt_en: Create a UEC senior-high chemistry teaching diagram for chapter 26, authentic subsection 26.4. Display the original Chinese title exactly: 有机鉴定的证据层级. teaching_purpose: 用sp杂化说明三键的线性几何
区分键总强度π反应性与端氢酸性
scientific_relations: 不把电子画成确定小球轨道
formulas_units_variables: C≡C=1σ+2π；两个π系统方向相互正交，σ沿核间轴。
三键碳sp模型，连接夹角约180°；整个长分子不必全线性。

tasks.prompt_zh: 为UEC高中化学第29章《炔烃》真实小节29.2《炔烃的结构》制作《炔烃sp与三键结构》教学图。学习目的：用sp杂化说明三键的线性几何；区分键总强度π反应性与端氢酸性。本图是有条件的科学模型，非实测图或官方考题。必须出现：H—C≡C—H线性骨架；轴向σ；两组正交p侧向重叠；端炔/内炔对比。必须保持关系：180°局部几何；1σ+2π；两π正交；不把电子画成确定小球轨道。中文标签逐字采用：sp、σ、π₁、π₂、180°、端氢。公式及条件：C≡C=1σ+2π；两个π系统方向相互正交，σ沿核间轴。；三键碳sp模型，连接夹角约180°；整个长分子不必全线性。；端炔R—C≡C—H有相应端氢，内炔R—C≡C—R′没有；弱酸性不等于能被任意弱碱定量去质子。。以2至3个逻辑清楚的面板排列，主结构居左或居上，计算/条件框居右或居下；箭头起止与文字引线不得穿过无关对象，不用颜色单独编码差异。使用浅底深线，必要以线型和形状区分，避免浅灰小字。建议1280×960、4:3，正文等效字号至少24 px，四周留48 px安全边距；手机可整体缩放并放大查看，最小标签不得裁切。科学结构、坐标、数值、曲线、刻度、单位和公式须用SVG或数学绘图库精确构造；若先用AI，只可作构图草稿，不能直接发布。逐项按验收标准复核。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a UEC senior-high chemistry teaching diagram for chapter 29, authentic subsection 29.2. Display the original Chinese title exactly: 炔烃sp与三键结构. Topic-specific scientific requirements and instructional purpose: Draw linear H-C≡C-H with sp-hybridized carbons, one axial sigma bond and two mutually perpendicular pi systems from unhybridized p orbitals. Contrast a terminal sp-C-H with an internal alkyne; do not draw three equivalent sigma rods or fixed electron trajectories. This is a conditional teaching model, not measured data or an official examination figure. Required Chinese-labelled objects, which must all appear: H—C≡C—H线性骨架；轴向σ；两组正交p侧向重叠；端炔/内炔对比. Typeset the reference formulas, units and conditions below as literal label/annotation content, checking every sign and symbol: C≡C=1σ+2π；两个π系统方向相互正交，σ沿核间轴。；三键碳sp模型，连接夹角约180°；整个长分子不必全线性。；端炔R—C≡C—H有相应端氢，内炔R—C≡C—R′没有；弱酸性不等于能被任意弱碱定量去质子。. Use two or three clearly separated panels, with the principal structure at top or left and condition/calculation boxes below or right. Never cross unrelated structures with arrows or callouts; every arrow must have a scientifically correct start and end. Never rely on colour alone: use shapes and line styles. Render a light background with dark high-contrast lines. Target 1280 by 960 pixels, 4:3, minimum 24-pixel equivalent labels and 48-pixel safe margins. tasks.subject: 数学
tasks.title: 内分与外分的权重
teaching_purpose: 由线性插值推导内分与外分坐标
反求端点并区分中点重心和无有限外分
formulas_units_variables: 内分AP:PB=m:n：P=(nA+mB)/(m+n)，m,n>0。
外分同长度比：P=(mB−nA)/(m−n)，m≠n；端点不同。
中点M=(A+B)/2；三角形重心G=(A+B+C)/3，可由中线2:1推导。
tasks.composition: 2–3个分面，主图和条件/计算框分开；精确方向和连接，48 px安全边距；不以颜色作为唯一编码。
tasks.prompt_zh: 为UEC高中数学第1章《直角坐标系与直线》真实小节1.2《定比分点》制作《内分与外分的权重》教学图。学习目的：由线性插值推导内分与外分坐标；反求端点并区分中点重心和无有限外分。本图是有条件的科学模型，非实测图或官方考题。必须出现：A(1,2)；B(7,8)；内分P(3,4)；外分P(13,14)；A侧外分。必须保持关系：内分1:2靠A；外分2:1越B；权重交叉；m=n外分无有限点。中文标签逐字采用：AP:PB、内分、外分、m,n>0、m≠n。公式及条件：内分AP:PB=m:n：P=(nA+mB)/(m+n)，m,n>0。；外分同长度比：P=(mB−nA)/(m−n)，m≠n；端点不同。；中点M=(A+B)/2；三角形重心G=(A+B+C)/3，可由中线2:1推导。。以2至3个逻辑清楚的面板排列，主结构居左或居上，计算/条件框居右或居下；箭头起止与文字引线不得穿过无关对象，不用颜色单独编码差异。使用浅底深线，必要以线型和形状区分，避免浅灰小字。建议1280×960、4:3，正文等效字号至少24 px，四周留48 px安全边距；手机可整体缩放并放大查看，最小标签不得裁切。科学结构、坐标、数值、曲线、刻度、单位和公式须用SVG或数学绘图库精确构造；若先用AI，只可作构图草稿，不能直接发布。逐项按验收标准复核。
tasks.prompt_en: Create a UEC senior-high mathematics teaching diagram for chapter 1, authentic subsection 1.2. Display the original Chinese title exactly: 内分与外分的权重. Topic-specific scientific requirements and instructional purpose: Place A(1,2), B(7,8), internal P(3,4) with AP:PB=1:2 and external P(13,14) with ratio 2:1 on the same line. Show crossed coordinate weights and distinguish an A-side external point; never draw an equal-ratio finite external division. This is a conditional teaching model, not measured data or an official examination figure. Required Chinese-labelled objects, which must all appear: A(1,2)；B(7,8)；内分P(3,4)；外分P(13,14)；A侧外分. Preserve the following Chinese label strings exactly: AP:PB、内分、外分、m,n>0、m≠n. Typeset the reference formulas, units and conditions below as literal label/annotation content, checking every sign and symbol: 内分AP:PB=m:n：P=(nA+mB)/(m+n)，m,n>0。；外分同长度比：P=(mB−nA)/(m−n)，m≠n；端点不同。；中点M=(A+B)/2；三角形重心G=(A+B+C)/3，可由中线2:1推导。. Use two or three clearly separated panels, with the principal structure at top or left and condition/calculation boxes below or right. Never cross unrelated structures with arrows or callouts; every arrow must have a scientifically correct start and end. Never rely on colour alone: use shapes and line styles. Render a light background with dark high-contrast lines. Target 1280 by 960 pixels, 4:3, minimum 24-pixel equivalent labels and 48-pixel safe margins. Keep every label inside the viewBox and support mobile zoom. Construct quantitative geometry, curves, tick marks, formulas, apparatus and scientific structures deterministically in SVG or a mathematical plotting library. AI output may only be a composition draft, requiring independent scientific checks before publication. The main figure is a specified model; do not silently transfer its numbers to a different worked example or exercise.
tasks.negative_prompt: 禁止错误或省略以下关系：内分1:2靠A；外分2:1越B；权重交叉；m=n外分无有限点。不得把定比分点画成另一知识主题；不得改动AP:PB、内分、外分、m,n>0、m≠n的数值、变量、正负号、上下标和单位。禁止中文乱码、英文替代必要中文、重复面板、无标尺却声称按比例、错误箭头、错误连接、把方向量当大小、把适用条件删去、截断文字、低对比、小字、装饰物遮挡结构、水印、虚构官方标志。不得将全部项目画成单一无条件因果链；不把AI生成的定量内容未经核验作为事实。

tasks.title: 斜率及例外分类
teaching_purpose: 用坐标差与倾斜角解释斜率
